name: macp_handoff_accept
description: HandoffAccept: the target accepts the offered transfer (RFC-MACP-0010 Section 4). Sent as message_type HandoffAccept in mode macp.mode.handoff.v1.

accepted_by.description: The participant accepting; must be the offer's target.

implicit.description: True on the runtime-emitted synthetic accept produced by acceptance.implicit_accept_timeout_ms (RFC-MACP-0010 §5.1). Clients MUST NOT submit an accept with implicit = true; runtimes MUST reject it.
